description: This source file implements a sample provider class for device data, including methods for retrieving manufacturer and model name, and registers this provider with a provider host. It includes class inheritance, method overriding, and a main function that runs a provider server.

classes.name: MyProvider
classes.description: A subclass of dmProvider that provides device manufacturer and model data, overriding base class methods to supply specific values and handle set requests.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: The entry point of the program which initializes a provider host, registers a MyProvider instance, and runs an infinite loop to keep the server active.

methods.name: dmValue getManufacturer()
methods.description: Returns a dmValue representing the manufacturer, hardcoded as 'Comcast'.

methods.name: dmValue getModelName()
methods.description: Returns a dmValue representing the model name, hardcoded as 'Xcam'.

methods.name: void setManufacturer(const std::string & name,const std::string & value)
methods.description: Handles setting the manufacturer value; currently, it just prints the change.

methods.name: void doGet(dmPropertyInfo const & param,dmQueryResult & result)
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle 'Manufacturer' and 'ModelName' get requests.

methods.name: void doSet(dmNamedValue const & param,dmQueryResult & result)
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle setting the 'Manufacturer' property.

ctags.name: doGet
ctags.pattern: /^  virtual void doGet(dmPropertyInfo const& param, dmQueryResult& result)$/

ctags.name: doSet
ctags.pattern: /^  virtual void doSet(dmNamedValue const& param, dmQueryResult& result)$/

ctags.name: setManufacturer
ctags.pattern: /^  void setManufacturer(const std::string& name, const std::string& value)$/
